company.name: Rewatch
company.shortDescription: Rewatch offers a private and secure video channel for teams.
company.description: Rewatch offers a private and secure video channel for teams. Rewatch transcribes your videos and unlocks your team’s spoken knowledge, making it searchable and organized—all in one place.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered tool that automatically records meetings, transcribes them, generates summaries, action items, and searchable transcripts to enhance team collaboration and productivity.
productsAndServices.name: AI Meeting Assistant

productsAndServices.description: A centralized platform to store, organize, search, and share all team videos, including meeting recordings and async updates, with features like transcripts, comments, and document attachments.
productsAndServices.name: Video Hub

productsAndServices.description: A tool to record asynchronous video updates with screen capture and camera overlay, enabling teams to share visual information without live meetings.
productsAndServices.name: Screen Recorder

productsAndServices.description: iOS and Android applications that enable users to watch, record, share videos, and collaborate with their team on the go.
productsAndServices.name: Mobile App

productsAndServices.description: An integration that embeds Rewatch videos into Lucidchart and Lucidspark documents and boards, linking visual collaboration with video content for enhanced project alignment.
productsAndServices.name: Lucid Integration
